description:
Troubleshoot a broken OSPF adjacency in a four-router ring. The network is pre-configured but R3 has a wrong OSPF area on the link to R2. Identify and fix the misconfiguration so all adjacencies are Full and end-to-end reachability is restored.

IP Addressing Plan:
- R1: eth1=10.0.12.1/30, eth2=10.0.14.1/30, lo=10.0.0.1/32
- R2: eth1=10.0.12.2/30, eth2=10.0.23.2/30, lo=10.0.0.2/32
- R3: eth1=10.0.23.3/30, eth2=10.0.34.3/30, lo=10.0.0.3/32
- R4: eth1=10.0.34.4/30, eth2=10.0.14.4/30, lo=10.0.0.4/32

properties.description: OSPF adjacency between R2 and R3 is Full after the fix
R2 has Full OSPF neighbors toward R1 and R3
R3 eth1 interface is in OSPF Area 0
R1 routing table contains OSPF routes

preconfiguration.command:
vtysh -c 'conf t
 interface lo
  ip address 10.0.0.1/32
 exit
 interface eth1
  ip address 10.0.12.1/30
 exit
 interface eth2
  ip address 10.0.14.1/30
 exit
 router ospf
  ospf router-id 10.0.0.1
  network 10.0.0.1/32 area 0
  network 10.0.12.0/30 area 0
  network 10.0.14.0/30 area 0'

vtysh -c 'conf t
 interface lo
  ip address 10.0.0.2/32
 exit
 interface eth1
  ip address 10.0.12.2/30
 exit
 interface eth2
  ip address 10.0.23.2/30
 exit
 router ospf
  ospf router-id 10.0.0.2
  network 10.0.0.2/32 area 0
  network 10.0.12.0/30 area 0
  network 10.0.23.0/30 area 0'

vtysh -c 'conf t
 interface lo
  ip address 10.0.0.3/32
 exit
 interface eth1
  ip address 10.0.23.3/30
 exit
 interface eth2
  ip address 10.0.34.3/30
 exit
 router ospf
  ospf router-id 10.0.0.3
  network 10.0.0.3/32 area 0
  network 10.0.23.0/30 area 1
  network 10.0.34.0/30 area 0'

vtysh -c 'conf t
 interface lo
  ip address 10.0.0.4/32
 exit
 interface eth1
  ip address 10.0.34.4/30
 exit
 interface eth2
  ip address 10.0.14.4/30
 exit
 router ospf
  ospf router-id 10.0.0.4
  network 10.0.0.4/32 area 0
  network 10.0.34.0/30 area 0
  network 10.0.14.0/30 area 0'

fault_verification.description: Adjacency R2-R3 is not Full before agent acts

optimal_solution.description: Fix R3 eth1 OSPF area from 1 to 0, verify adjacency and reachability
